svg.title: Pea flower color through parental, F1 and F2 generations
svg.desc: A purple and a white true-breeding parent produce purple F1 hybrids. Self- or cross-pollination produces F2 plants shown as three purple flower icons and one white. Observed counts are 705 purple-flowered plants and 224 white-flowered plants; icon counts are schematic. Original pea flowers reuse accepted banner, wings, paired keel, calyx and connected stem geometry.
